target_customer: Power Excel users at consulting, investment banking, private equity, advisory and audit firms
problem: Experts spend hours checking workbooks, building models and linking data from documents into templates, and general AI agents struggle with interlinked formulas, sheets and ranges.
business_model: B2B SaaS, access granted firm by firm
product_category: AI agents for Excel and PowerPoint, finance workflows

founders.name: Philip Borge
education: MSc Finance & Private Equity, London School of Economics
founders.background_notes: Former PE consultant per YC page.

founders.name: Michael Sakowski
education: Master's in Banking & Finance, University of St. Gallen
founders.background_notes: Earlier investment banking and private equity experience per YC page.

founders.name: Markus Skagemo
founders.background_notes: Data scientist; won BearingPoint's Global Innovation Award per YC page.

competitors.name: Microsoft Copilot Agent Mode in Excel
competitors.what: Multi-step agent inside Excel that plans, edits and checks workbooks

technical_complexity.rationale: Reliable multi-step edits over thousands of interlinked formulas is hard for LLM agents, but the team builds on frontier models and Office plug-ins.

defensibility.rationale: Microsoft and model labs ship Excel agents, so the moat rests on firm specific methodology, templates, security certifications and domain depth.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Microsoft shipped Agent Mode in Excel from September 2025 and Claude for Excel launched in early 2026 per Shortcut's page; Crunched itself is cited as a Claude customer.

market_need_then: Excel has over a billion users and finance and consulting teams spend large time on model building and checking; the founders cite early access to customers in six European countries.

branding.domain_note: Uses usecrunched.com, a use prefix, rather than crunched.com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Practical, for people who live in Excel, claims of hours saved

branding.community_and_virality: No evidence of merch or community; featured in an Anthropic customer story.

brand_strength.rationale: Little brand specific coverage found; the prefixed domain and generic verb name show no sign of a brand driven growth.

outcome_analysis: Crunched is active and early. Two ex-McKinsey finance founders and two Norwegian AI engineers joined YC in Fall 2025 and reportedly raised a 6M dollar seed led by First Round within months. The main threat is Microsoft and model labs shipping Excel agents, so it relies on firm specific depth and security credentials.
notes: Seed amount comes from one outlet plus CB Insights total of 6.5M and a Norwegian job listing citing NOK 55M; the outlet calls the company San Francisco based while YC lists Oslo. Seed date is unknown (article updated January 2026). A 500K pre-seed dated December 2025 appears only on aggregators and is not recorded as a round. Competitor traction and funding are not verified.
